name: Tousui Kitan
source:
There is a mysterious ancestral ways in the village. Don't speak loudly at night, Don't fight against others at night, Don't show up at night if you are a woman..... All the people in the village has the same surname.....

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE021838.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
村庄里流传着神秘的祖训：夜晚不要大声说话，夜晚不要与人争斗，女性夜晚不要现身……村里所有人都姓同一个姓……

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE021838.html]English DLsite[/url]]
